solo.contentHtml:
◆
Core-Set Selection (Geometric k-Center): Formulates active batch selection as finding a subset of points \mathbf{s} \subseteq \mathcal{U} that minimizes the maximum Euclidean distance from any unlabeled point to its nearest labeled neighbor, bounding empirical risk via Lipschitz continuity .
▸
Query-By-Committee (QBC): Maintains an ensemble or "committee" of distinct models to evaluate consensus variance \mathcal{C} = \{f_1, and so on, f_M\} trained on different bootstraps or architectures; queries points where the committee members exhibit maximal prediction disagreement .
⚡
BADGE (Batch Active Learning by Diverse Gradient Embeddings): Computes hallucinated gradient embeddings for the final classification layer, then applies k-Means++ initialization to simultaneously select points with high model gradient magnitude (uncertainty) and diverse feature directions (coverage) .
